correctness.rationale: The final statement defines the dual incidence poset with maximal vertex worlds and minimal edge worlds. For a vertex trace S an upset has 2^{|E(G[S])|} choices of eligible edge worlds, establishing Z(G). At any edge world e with upper cone {e,u,v}, both Heyting implications fail precisely when the two endpoints have opposite pure membership states (10,01) or (01,10): an edge-world cannot itself witness one difference while the opposite difference is present because its membership forces both endpoints. Each edge world then contributes 2^{a1b1+a2b2}, except forbidden opposite-pure pairs, giving exactly the claimed 4x4 W and A(G)/Z(G)^2. Rooted-tree factorization proves four-state forest messages and corresponding two-state messages for Z; O(|V|) counts arithmetic operations, not bit cost. On paths, transfer identities A_m=1^T W^{m-1}1 and Z_m=1^T B^{m-1}1 yield A_1=4,A_2=23,A_3=147, recurrence characteristic t^3-7t^2+3t+2, and Z_m=F_{2m+1}. The W eigenvalue 2 is orthogonal to the all-ones boundary vector. Perron vectors yield C=(1^T u)^2/(1^T v)^4>0 and B⊗B strictly dominates W, giving rho(W)<alpha^2 with alpha=(3+sqrt5)/2. E empty iff universally prelinear follows from U={u},V={v} for any edge, and Booleanity for edgeless graphs. Independently reconstructed 76 graph cases (all graphs on 0..4 vertices), 117152 ordered upset pairs, and exact matrix recurrences through m=22; no finite computation was used as proof of an unrestricted claim.

value.rationale: Prelinearity is a basic non-Boolean logical equation and its probability of truth under uniform random valuations is a natural invariant. The result gives an exact all-finite-graph evaluation by a nontrivial four-state edge interaction; the associated tree recursion reduces exponential upset-pair enumeration to linear graph-size arithmetic operations on forests. The cubic path recurrence and quantitative Perron ratio approximately 0.946920871 imply exponential decay despite every nonmaximal world having exactly two maximal successors. This establishes a substantive structural mechanism and asymptotic phenomenon, not a textbook substitution, small case, or unmotivated table. The role of graph orientation, probability normalization and arithmetic-versus-bit complexity is stated explicitly.

final_claim: For every finite simple graph G, the probability of Heyting prelinearity over two independently uniform upsets of the dual vertex-maximal incidence poset is A(G)/Z(G)^2 for its exact stated 4x4 W and Z induced-edge-weight sum; tree recursions, path recurrence/Fibonacci law and sharp Perron decay hold, with universal satisfaction iff G is edgeless.
limitations: Finite independently reproduced data do not establish the universal all-graph theorem; the combinatorial proof does.
The asymptotic is for paths only; bit-cost and nonuniform sampling are outside the claim.
Search coverage is necessarily bounded; originality remains qualified best-of-knowledge.
